events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 and would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to rock the world, and we're paying tribute to the Queen legend who would have been 80 this year.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that redefined pop music and showed their incredible evolution. Still sounds fresh, doesn't it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980 and would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the music world lost a true icon. John Lennon's influence is still felt deeply today, and we're honouring the man who would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: On this day, we celebrate the life and legacy of the iconic David Bowie, who would have turned 80.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. From Ziggy Stardust to the Thin White Duke, David Bowie's artistry continues to inspire. A true legend.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: We remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Elvis Presley's music and charisma changed the world forever, and his legend lives on.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar Wizard's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard himself, Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin co-founder's riffs are still as electrifying as ever.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Sir Rod's 82nd
angles.copy: It's Sir Rod's 82nd birthday! From the Faces to his incredible solo career, Rod Stewart's voice is unmistakable. Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs' 66th
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us those absolute bangers for decades.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That voice defined a generation, and his hits are still on heavy rotation.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly's 81st
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon, songwriter, and philanthropist. What a woman!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's 56th
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the songwriting legend, Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo career, he's given us so many unforgettable tunes.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to Billy Ocean! Get out your dancing shoes, because we're celebrating with some of his timeless classics.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring legends like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall of Fame's First
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Imagine being there to see those legends recognised!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen's 55th
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Another Take That legend celebrating today. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil's 76th
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, his music is truly timeless.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's 46th
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo stardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly for Sir David
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Sir David Jason turns 87 today. A true national treasure who has given us countless classic TV moments.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering the Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, the music world lost three incredible talents in what became known as 'The Day The Music Died'. Their legacy lives on through their timeless songs.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and recent resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick's 61st
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Never gonna give up on his incredible tunes. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: We remember the reggae legend Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley's 82nd
angles.copy: The King of Reggae would have been 82 today. Bob Marley's message of peace, love, and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King's 85th
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting genius who has penned some of the most iconic songs in history.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012 and would have been 64.

angles.name: Whitney's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. Whitney Houston's legacy lives on through her powerful music.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Take That's Heartbreak Day
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years ago, the nation collectively wept as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they're back and better than ever!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell's 68th
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell! The voice of UB40, bringing us those reggae-pop vibes for decades. Red, Red Wine anyone?

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed's 36th
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! From busking to selling out stadiums, what an incredible journey.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: We remember The Beatles' "Quiet Beatle," George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Quiet Beatle's 84th
angles.copy: The 'Quiet Beatle' would have been 84 today. George Harrison's songwriting and guitar work left an indelible mark on music history.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Roger Daltrey's 83rd
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey! The voice of The Who, still rocking stages around the world.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 69th birthday.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw's 69th
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to Nik Kershaw! Still 'Wouldn't It Be Good' to hear his classics on the radio? We think so!

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Martin's 50th
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin! Half a century young and still making anthems that fill stadiums worldwide.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Bon Jovi's 65th
angles.copy: Whoa, we're halfway there! Jon Bon Jovi turns 65 today. Still a rock icon, still living on a prayer!

events.title: Chris Rea turns 76
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Chris Rea celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea's 76th
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Chris Rea! Still driving home for Christmas, and still giving us those incredible blues-rock vibes.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: We remember Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Mary Wilson's 83rd
angles.copy: The Supremes' legendary Mary Wilson would have been 83 today. Her voice helped define an era of Motown magic.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Numan's 69th
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the iconic Gary Numan! Are 'Friends' Electric? We're certainly feeling the static from his incredible career.
